scenario_name: 健康負樣本：沒有故障——電網電壓驟降、電網頻率越界、風向快速變化（偏航逾時）、一台主軸承 Pt100 接點鬆動

cases.fault_name_zh: 主軸承溫度 1 Pt100 接觸不良（nuisance）
cases.root_cause: 主軸承溫度 1 的 Pt100 接點鬆動（nuisance 跳機）：每隔一陣子斷開幾秒，PLC 每次都送軸承溫度 1 故障（242）跳機，接回後讀值正常、機組自動重啟；軸承本身與其他訊號都正常。一小時內超過自動重啟上限時會送 A039、要操作員復位。手冊 §11.3 把 Pt100 鬆線列為已知無害、可設定自動重啟的 nuisance 跳機。
cases.root_cause_en: A loose contact on the main bearing temperature 1 Pt100 (nuisance trip): every so often it opens for a few seconds, the PLC trips with bearing 1 temperature fault (242) each time, and once it closes again the reading is normal and the turbine restarts; the bearing and all other signals are fine. Exceeding the auto-restart limit within an hour raises A039 and needs an operator reset. The manual (§11.3) lists a loose Pt100 wire as a known harmless nuisance trip that can be given an auto-restart setting.

manual_refs.cause: The I/O module has sensed a broken wire
manual_refs.rectification: Check wiring to the Pt100 sensor

expected_actions: 檢查軸承溫度 1 的 Pt100 配線與端子是否鬆動（手冊）
看 242 的模式：短暫跳機後讀值立刻正常、反覆出現，且軸承溫度 2 與振動正常，是接觸不良而不是軸承或感測器壞掉
鎖緊接點；修好前可依手冊把這個跳機的自動重啟次數設高（手冊 §11.3），修好後改回 0
expected_actions_en: Check the bearing temperature 1 Pt100 wiring and terminals for a loose connection (manual).

Look at the 242 pattern: brief trips with a normal reading right after, recurring, while bearing temperature 2 and vibration are normal, point to a loose contact rather than a failed bearing or sensor.
Tighten the connection; until it is fixed, the auto-restart setting for this trip can be raised as the manual describes (§11.3) and set back to 0 afterwards.
simulation_notes: 注入後 5–20 分鐘第一次瞬斷，之後每 15–45 分鐘一次、每次 10–30 秒；瞬斷時讀值同斷線（850 °C），與嚴重度無關。
模擬器假設這個跳機的自動重啟已開啟（上限照手冊 Appendix C 的每小時次數；手冊 §11.3 的出廠設定是 0）。
simulation_notes_en: The first glitch comes 5–20 min after injection, then every 15–45 min for 10–30 s each; during a glitch the reading is the broken-wire value (850 °C), independent of severity.
The simulator assumes auto restart is enabled for this trip (limited per hour as in the manual's Appendix C; the factory setting in §11.3 is 0).

cases.root_cause: 電網側電壓驟降（外部電網事件，不是機組故障）：全場機組幾乎同時以電網保護 / 欠壓停機，電壓恢復後自動重啟。
cases.root_cause_en: A grid-side voltage dip (external grid event, not a turbine fault): the turbines trip on grid protection / undervoltage almost simultaneously and restart automatically once the voltage is back.

expected_alarm_sequence.text: Undervoltage ARU phase R-S very low

manual_refs.text: Undervoltage ARU phase R-S very low
manual_refs.cause: See [ABB]
manual_refs.rectification: See [ABB]

manual_refs.cause: A turbine trip request is issued by the converter control system
manual_refs.rectification: This trip comes in combination with a trip in the range 400-700. See [ABB] for troubleshooting

expected_actions: 比對全場機組：同一時刻多台跳同樣的電網碼，是電網事件而不是機組故障
向電網調度 / 變電站確認事件紀錄，確認電壓已恢復
機組自動重啟即可；一小時內多次封鎖重啟（A039）時由操作員復位（手冊）
expected_actions_en: Compare across the farm: several turbines tripping on the same grid event at the same moment points to the grid, not a turbine fault.
Confirm the event with the grid operator / substation log and that the voltage has recovered.
Let the turbines restart automatically; if auto restart is blocked (A039) after repeated trips, reset by an operator (manual).
simulation_notes: 風場電網模型在事件期間把電壓固定在設定值（加量測雜訊）；各機組依個體差的保護裕度決定停不停。
simulation_notes_en: The farm grid model holds the voltage at the set value (plus measurement noise) during the event; each turbine trips or rides through according to its individual protection margin.

cases.root_cause: 電網頻率越界（外部電網事件，不是機組故障）：全場機組以頻率越界停機，頻率恢復後自動重啟。
cases.root_cause_en: A grid frequency excursion (external grid event, not a turbine fault): the turbines trip on frequency out of bounds and restart automatically once the frequency is back.

cases.root_cause: 風向在短時間內大幅來回變化（環境因素，不是偏航系統故障）：偏航追不上而逾時跳機（223），風向穩定後自動重啟；手冊 §11.3 列為已知無害的 nuisance 跳機。
cases.root_cause_en: The wind direction swings strongly within a short time (environmental, not a yaw system fault): the yaw cannot keep up and times out (223), restarting automatically once the direction settles; the manual (§11.3) lists this as a known harmless nuisance trip.

manual_refs.cause: Yawing the turbine into the wind took too long
manual_refs.rectification: Is there a problem with (one of) the yaw motors ? Alternatively, it is possible that the wind direction changed too much while yawing had started

expected_actions: 比對風向趨勢與同風場其他機組：多台在風向劇烈變化時偏航逾時，是環境造成
確認偏航馬達、煞車與齒輪沒有異常（逾時只在風向劇變時出現）
此場址常見時，可依手冊把偏航逾時的自動重啟次數設高（手冊 §11.3），問題排除後再改回
expected_actions_en: Compare the wind direction trend and the other turbines: several yaw time-outs while the direction swings point to the environment.
Confirm the yaw motors, brakes and gears are fine (the time-outs only happen during the swings).
Where this is common at the site, raise the auto-restart setting for the yaw time-out as the manual describes (§11.3), and set it back afterwards.
simulation_notes: 風向以 180 秒週期正弦擺動（開頭 / 結尾各 60 秒漸強 / 漸弱），全場同一個擺動；真實的風向變化不規則、各機組略有時差。
振幅約 26° 以下時風向變化率不超過偏航最快速度，偏航追得上、不會逾時（事件照樣記在標準答案，但沒有 case）。
模擬器假設偏航逾時的自動重啟已開啟（上限照手冊 Appendix C 的每小時次數；手冊 §11.3 的出廠設定是 0）。
simulation_notes_en: The direction swings sinusoidally with a 180 s period (ramped in / out over 60 s) and is identical across the farm; real direction changes are irregular and reach the turbines at slightly different times.
Below an amplitude of about 26° the direction changes no faster than the yaw can turn, so it never times out (the event is still listed in the answer key, with no cases).
The simulator assumes auto restart is enabled for the yaw time-out (limited per hour as in the manual's Appendix C; the factory setting in §11.3 is 0).

farm_events.magnitude_unit: Hz（相對額定頻率的偏移，可正可負）
度（風向來回擺動的振幅）
